title: The $200M Machine that Prints Microchips:  The EUV Photolithography System
summary: Branch Education's animated deep dive into ASML's EUV photolithography machine and how it prints nanometer-scale transistors onto chips. It covers the system's components and the process of chip manufacturing.
why: HN sends people here as the most straightforward and detailed starting point for understanding EUV lithography.

quote.text: I highly recommend watching this video about lithography and the machine that makes it all possible
